WbsoBeschikking.title: WBSO Beschikking
WbsoBeschikking.description: RVO grant decision (beschikking) awarding S&O (Speur- en Ontwikkelingswerk) hours for a WBSO project (REQ-WBSO-001). Records the granted ceiling of S&O hours and the hourly rate against which the realisatie (SoUurregistratie) and the closing WbsoMededeling are validated. The granted hours form the immutable ceiling that the mededeling realisatie may never exceed (REQ-WBSO-005).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Beschikking changes (rate corrections, granted-hour adjustments, state flips) MUST be audit-trail-immutable per ADR-022 — the granted ceiling governs every downstream realisatie and the closing mededeling.

granted.label: Granted
granted.description: Active RVO grant; S&O hours may be booked against this beschikking (REQ-WBSO-001).

expired.label: Expired
expired.description: The grant period has ended; no further realisatie may be booked (REQ-WBSO-001).

withdrawn.label: Withdrawn
withdrawn.description: The grant was withdrawn by RVO; the beschikking no longer authorises any S&O hours (REQ-WBSO-001).

expire.label: Expire beschikking
expire.description: Close the grant once its period has elapsed (REQ-WBSO-001).

withdraw.label: Withdraw beschikking
withdraw.description: Record an RVO withdrawal of the grant (REQ-WBSO-001).

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration entity that owns this beschikking (REQ-WBSO-001).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

decisionNumber.description: RVO beschikking number identifying the grant decision (REQ-WBSO-001). Unique per administration.
decisionNumber.title: Beschikking Number

rvoReference.description: RVO case reference for the grant application/decision (REQ-WBSO-001).
rvoReference.title: Rvo Reference

projectNumber.description: WBSO project number the granted S&O hours belong to (REQ-WBSO-001).
projectNumber.title: Project Number

grantedSoHours.description: Ceiling of S&O hours granted by RVO. The closing mededeling realisatie may never exceed this value (REQ-WBSO-001 / REQ-WBSO-005).
grantedSoHours.title: Granted So Hours

soHourlyRate.description: Statutory S&O hourly rate applied to the granted hours (REQ-WBSO-001).
soHourlyRate.title: So Hourly Rate

SoUurregistratie.title: S&O Uurregistratie
SoUurregistratie.description: S&O (Speur- en Ontwikkelingswerk) hour registration booked by a Nextcloud employee against a WBSO beschikking (REQ-WBSO-002). The employee is the Nextcloud identity, not an app-local person schema (ADR-022). Daily hours are capped at 24. Confirmed registrations accumulate into the realisatie that the WbsoMededeling reports against the granted ceiling.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: S&O hour registrations MUST be audit-trail-immutable per ADR-022 — locked registrations form the realisatie reported in the WBSO mededeling.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Entered but not yet confirmed; editable by the booking employee (REQ-WBSO-002).

confirmed.label: Confirmed
confirmed.description: Confirmed by the employee and counted toward the realisatie (REQ-WBSO-002).

locked.label: Locked
locked.description: Locked once the period mededeling is submitted; no further edits (REQ-WBSO-002).

confirm.label: Confirm hours
confirm.description: Confirm the booked S&O hours so they count toward the realisatie (REQ-WBSO-002).

lock.label: Lock hours
lock.description: Lock confirmed hours when the period mededeling is submitted (REQ-WBSO-002).

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration entity that owns this registration (REQ-WBSO-002).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

employeeId.description: Nextcloud user id of the employee who performed the S&O work (REQ-WBSO-002 / ADR-022). The Nextcloud identity is reused, not an app-local person schema.
employeeId.title: Employee ID

decisionNumber.description: RVO beschikking number the hours are booked against (REQ-WBSO-002).
decisionNumber.title: Beschikking Number

workDate.description: Date the S&O work was performed (REQ-WBSO-002).
workDate.title: Work Date

hours.description: S&O hours booked on the work date. Capped at 24 hours per day (REQ-WBSO-002).
hours.title: Hours

description.description: Description of the S&O activity performed (REQ-WBSO-002).
description.title: Description

WbsoMededeling.title: WBSO Mededeling
WbsoMededeling.description: WBSO realisatie mededeling reporting the realised S&O hours for a beschikking period to RVO (REQ-WBSO-003). The realised hours may never exceed the beschikking's granted ceiling — the submit and resubmit transitions are guarded by WbsoMededeligGuard::canSubmit which enforces this ceiling (REQ-WBSO-005).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Mededeling submissions MUST be audit-trail-immutable per ADR-022 — the mededeling is the statutory realisatie report filed with RVO.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Realisatie being assembled; editable by the bookkeeper (REQ-WBSO-003).

submitted.label: Submitted
submitted.description: Submitted to RVO and awaiting acceptance (REQ-WBSO-003).

rejected.label: Rejected
rejected.description: Rejected by RVO; may be corrected and resubmitted (REQ-WBSO-003).

submit.label: Submit mededeling
submit.description: Submit the realisatie mededeling to RVO. Guarded to ensure the realised S&O hours never exceed the beschikking's granted ceiling (REQ-WBSO-003 / REQ-WBSO-005).

resubmit.label: Resubmit mededeling
resubmit.description: Resubmit a corrected mededeling after an RVO rejection. Re-applies the realisatie-ceiling guard (REQ-WBSO-003 / REQ-WBSO-005).

accept.label: Accept mededeling
accept.description: Record RVO acceptance of the mededeling (REQ-WBSO-003).

reject.label: Reject mededeling
reject.description: Record RVO rejection of the mededeling (REQ-WBSO-003).

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration entity that owns this mededeling (REQ-WBSO-003).
administrationId.title: Administration ID

decisionNumber.description: RVO beschikking number whose realisatie this mededeling reports (REQ-WBSO-003).
decisionNumber.title: Beschikking Number

realisedSoHours.description: Total realised S&O hours reported to RVO. May never exceed the beschikking's granted ceiling (REQ-WBSO-003 / REQ-WBSO-005).
realisedSoHours.title: Realised So Hours

reportingPeriodEnd.description: End date of the reporting period covered by this mededeling (REQ-WBSO-003).
reportingPeriodEnd.title: Reporting Period End
